module.name: Breast cancer
module.description: Example module file with an indexed cohort: every patient diagnosed with breast cancer (254837009), alive or deceased. The stage group is the first observation 21908-9 from the diagnosis; the stage texts of the two families Synthea writes (Stage 1, Stage 1A, ... and American Joint Committee on Cancer stage IA, ...) are grouped under Stage 1 to Stage 4, so a patient with two rows of the same stage on that date counts once. The crossing measures the deaths inside each stage group. A death counts as caused by breast cancer when the cause of death observation (69453-9) has that text.

Stage 1: American Joint Committee on Cancer stage IA (qualifier value)
American Joint Committee on Cancer stage IB (qualifier value)
Stage 2: American Joint Committee on Cancer stage IIA (qualifier value)
American Joint Committee on Cancer stage IIB (qualifier value)
Stage 3: American Joint Committee on Cancer stage IIIA (qualifier value)
American Joint Committee on Cancer stage IIIB (qualifier value)
American Joint Committee on Cancer stage IIIC (qualifier value)
